gitCommit.subject: feat: tooling batch + every remaining epic follow-up — zero suppressions, zero known vulns (purses-9oxh.7 + 9 more) (#335)
gitCommit.body: feat: tooling batch + every remaining epic follow-up — zero suppressions, zero known vulns (purses-9oxh.7 + 9 more) (#335) * feat(deps): tooling batch — TS 6, Vite 8, ulid 3, dotenv 17, @types/node 24; Node truth aligned (purses-9oxh.7 + .1) typescript 6.0.3 (tsc baseline 97 -> 97, zero new errors), vite 8.1.0 + plugin-react 6.0.3, dotenv 17.4.2, ulid 3.0.2 with its lexicographic ordering PINNED (decision-order.test.ts, seed-time deterministic — ranking replay ties on id). Node truth from the authoritative source: Vercel project nodeVersion 24.x; .nvmrc + all 7 CI jobs 22 -> 24; engines was already right; @types/node ^20 -> ^24.13.2. All picks quarantine-selected. TWO recorded holds, bead-owned: TS 7 (typescript-eslint <6.1.0 peer cap) and ESLint 10 (purses-9oxh.11 — eslint-config-next@16's nested eslint-plugin-react calls the removed context.getFilename; peers said >=9, runtime said no). .claude/** added to eslint ignores (stale worktree node_modules crash vector). ARCHITECTURE decision 38; osv esbuild ignore revisited and re-pointed. Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CFBKAkT5Z2b8uamK46Yepa * feat(db): NOT NULL the columns the code already guarantees; kill row:any at the mapper boundary purses-mebk.2 + purses-22rp, and the second found the third: - sessions.number, sort_results.number -> NOT NULL (both allocated at INSERT; a NULL was already unreachable). Empty DB = a metadata-only ALTER, which is exactly why the bead said do it now. - photos.is_hero -> NOT NULL. Found by removing `row: any`: the column was `boolean | null` while Photo.isHero promised `boolean` — the SAME laundering the number columns had. `any` at the DB boundary defeats the guarantee the NOT NULL work exists to buy. - Every repository mapper now takes `typeof .$inferSelect` instead of `any`. That surfaced: a numeric/string write mismatch on score+confidence (drizzle reads AND writes numeric as string), dead `?? null` coalesces on columns that were never null, and union narrowings the `any` was silently supplying. Proven to bite: flipping a domain field's nullability now fails the build where it used to compile in silence. - purses-mebk.1: scripts/migration-hashes.test.ts pins the SHA-256 of every committed migration. drizzle's migrator compares only the journal timestamp and NEVER reads the hash back, so an edited/re-baselined migration replays silently — green CI, red prod deploy. Mutation-proven: one changed byte reds it. Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CFBKAkT5Z2b8uamK46Yepa * fix(react): re-enable the react-hooks compiler rules — 25 sites fixed, zero suppressions purses-9oxh.8. The eslint-config-next@16 bump enabled react-hooks@7's compiler rules (set-state-in-effect, purity, refs) as errors; the tailwind PR parked them behind a temporary disable block. Block deleted, every site fixed on its merits — no eslint-disable comments anywhere: - device-local reads in mount effects -> useSyncExternalStore (src/lib/useDeviceValue.ts); useReducedMotion rewritten on it, since a media query genuinely IS an external store - Date.now() during render -> useState lazy initializer (a mount-fixed clock, which is what the code always meant) - refs read/written during render -> state snapshots, or moved into effects declared above their readers so commit order is unchanged Plus purses-q228, which turned out to be two bugs, not one flake: - the spec waited on page.waitForResponse (resolves when Playwright's network layer sees the response) while the app clears the queue strictly later, after a second async body read inside a web lock. Now polls the real signal. - the stumble line rendered CONDITIONALLY above the card, shifting the answer buttons under the user's finger — the intercepting- click failure. It was also a role=status region mounted with its content, which AT never announces. Now persistently mounted at fixed height: a11y fix, UX fix, flake fix. Verified 5/5 consecutive full-spec runs (and 10/10 repeat-each on the pagehide test). Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CFBKAkT5Z2b8uamK46Yepa * fix(deps): both osv advisories FIXED, not ignored — osv-scanner.toml deleted purses-9oxh.9 + the esbuild ignore. The repo now carries ZERO suppressions and ZERO known vulnerabilities; the ignore file is gone entirely. - postcss 8.4.31 (pinned inside next@16, GHSA-qx2v-qp2m-jg93): overrides {"postcss": "$postcss"} + direct dep ^8.5.18. npm REJECTS a bare override that conflicts with a direct dependency — the $name reference form is the correct one. Tree now resolves to a single postcss 8.5.18. - esbuild 0.18.20 (GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99): dragged in by @esbuild-kit/core-utils, which is DEPRECATED ("Merged into tsx", last published 2023-09) and which drizzle-kit STILL depends on at its latest version — no upgrade escapes it. Scoped override to 0.25.12, the version drizzle-kit already uses at top level. Proven, not hoped: `npm run db:generate` runs clean against it. - scripts/overrides.test.ts is the tripwire: it FAILS if drizzle-kit ever drops @esbuild-kit (delete the override then, don't carry it forever) or if either override stops applying. An override with no reason left is a silent lie. - purses-9oxh.10: @theme -> @theme inline; the tool's border-color compat shim deleted (zero bare borders exist). purses-mebk.3: dead db:backfill-slugs script + README line deleted. ARCHITECTURE decisions 38-39. Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CFBKAkT5Z2b8uamK46Yepa * test(e2e): poll the queue's real completion signal, not the network response (purses-q228) Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CFBKAkT5Z2b8uamK46Yepa * chore: graphify update at PR boundary Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CFBKAkT5Z2b8uamK46Yepa * docs: sync the living docs to the new state (decisions 35 superseded, 40 added) /sync-docs pass the PR was missing: - ARCHITECTURE 35 asserted a committed osv-scanner.toml as current; the file is deleted (39 supersedes). Marked, not silently rewritten. - DEPLOYMENT said findings are ignored 'only via the committed toml' — there is no toml and no suppressions now, so ANY finding is a real finding. - NEW decision 40: the NOT NULL columns + row:any removal had no entry at all. They are one finding, not two — photos.is_hero was FOUND by removing the any. docs/superpowers/** deliberately untouched: specs, plans and the handoff are frozen historical records; rewriting them would falsify the account. Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CFBKAkT5Z2b8uamK46Yepa * docs: DATABASE.md — this repo's DB conventions as they are today (purses-06a, purses-vg8w) purses-06a asked for a PROJECT-SPECIFIC reference (a prior attempt was rejected as generic filler). Current state, not history: PK/ULID convention and its load-bearing lexicographic ordering, soft-delete and the findByIdIncludingDeleted purge rule, the catalog-number unique indexes, the partial unique indexes and the every-writer-into-the-slot rule, the CHECK constraint, FK cascade vs no-cascade vs no-FK-by-design (audit_log), and which columns are NOT NULL vs nullable and why. Migration section is a WORKFLOW, with the three traps that actually bite: dotenv silently targets dev; vercel-build auto-migrates prod at build time (⇒ expand/contract for destructive DDL); the migrator never reads the recorded hash back (⇒ scripts/migration-hashes.test.ts). The decision history stays in ARCHITECTURE's log — this page does not repeat it. purses-vg8w resolved: DEPLOYMENT.md claimed the e2e Postgres uses a worktree-derived slot/port and that CI no longer pins DATABASE_URL_TEST. BOTH false — test-db.sh:20-22 hardcodes pi-e2e-db/:5433 and ci.yml:482 pins it. The doc described an unshipped design; the code was right. Fixed the doc, and distinguished the e2e container from db-tests' :5432 service. Deliberately NOT written: an ERD/data dictionary (it would be a hand-maintained duplicate of schema.ts that rots), and Neon backup product detail that isn't verifiable from the repo. Omitted rather than invented. Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CFBKAkT5Z2b8uamK46Yepa --------- Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8

specs.title: authenticate
a11y: core authed screens — no serious/critical violations (light)
a11y: core authed screens — no serious/critical violations (dark)
a11y: unauthenticated login/signup — no serious/critical violations (light)
a11y: unauthenticated login/signup — no serious/critical violations (dark)
pool-first: Make items routes to the pool
both: Photo pool renders before Items, with the item preview shown
items-first: View all items routes to the items grid
empty: offers exactly one add-photos action and no pool/items sections
keyboard traversal reaches header → primary section → secondary actions → owner utilities in order
UI login redirects to /collections and the session survives middleware
after UI login, direct navigation to a protected route stays authenticated
login with bad credentials establishes no session and shows an error
login with good credentials signs in as that user
signup creates a fresh account and signs in as that user

suites.title: compare — which do you love more?

specs.title: renders the prompt, two choice cards, and quiet Tie/Skip escapes
tapping a card chooses it and the next pair (or a graceful end) appears
gentle progress text appears after a comparison is made
crash-reload: the gate drains pending decisions in queue order BEFORE the round re-renders
pagehide: a still-pending decision is delivered on unload and persists
owner types the name to permanently delete, then lands on /collections

suites.title: delete photo from the item carousel

specs.title: deleting the only photo (real DELETE) returns the add-photos CTA
the items grid requests the resized card width (w=640)
the item-detail hero requests the large width (w=1280)
rotate from a card fires a persisted PATCH and announces the result
zoom in changes the image scale
flips to the next photo and shows the details card
the view control opens the zoom/rotate viewer
